title: Excellent!!
text: Amazing!! We had the BEST time on our private sailing trip with Jose ("Pepo"). We did a 2 hour sailing trip with our family of 4 (2 adults and 2 kids - ages 11 and 13).  Pepo was outstanding - super friendly, easy going, truly showed us a great time.  We swam and cruised around while enjoying delicious cava, beer, cheese, and snacks.  The sailboat was beautiful and very well maintained.  Everything was perfect and I would absolutely recommend this company (specifically Pepo).  10 stars!
author: A2990ZRshannonh
